children: New Mountain Finance extended its stock repurchase program through December 31, 2027, retaining authorization to buy back up to $150 million of common stock.
The board extended the program, which had been set to expire on December 31, 2026.
Approximately $70 million of repurchases have been completed to date under the program.
Repurchases are discretionary, and the company is not obligated to buy shares; timing and amount will depend on market conditions and other factors.
The board cited market volatility and uncertainty that may cause shares to be undervalued as reasons for extending the program.
